name: batch7
rows: black semi-automatic shotgun built like an assault rifle: a black plastic fixed stock with a pistol-style grip behind the trigger, a black receiver, a short black handguard, a long thin barrel, and a large curved black box magazine under the receiver. No cards, no labels.

integrally suppressed sniper rifle: a light-wood thumbhole stock with two big openings and a black rubber butt pad, a black steel receiver, a short straight box magazine, and a thick black cylindrical suppressor covering the whole front of the barrel with a small front sight at its end. No scope.

drum-fed riot shotgun: a very large round black drum cylinder in the middle, a black skeletal shoulder stock with a rubber butt pad, a black pistol grip, a black vertical foregrip near the front, and a long plain black barrel above the drum.
